answer: A fresh agent is raw basalt: its stake stays frozen and its vote weighs little until history accrues. Trust builds like water seeping into an oasis, and only sustained honest work unlocks withdrawal. So a Sybil farm must duplicate the full deposit plus waiting period for every key, while fees, slash risk and idle capital compound. The hundredth fake agent costs the same as the first. Counterparty checks keep the pool clear as quartz, each identity visible and individually bonded. Cheap sockpuppets stop being cheap.
